Yuuko Morino is a main character of Tentacle and Witches.

She is a human witch/Onmyoji and teacher, she is the current "Witch of the Great Ocean".

Even from a magical perspective, ninjutsu is interesting. Genetic traits, differences in individual strength... it's definitely worth looking into.
Morino Yuuko

Personality
Dedicated in her task to protect Tachibana Ichiro, often acts less than a teacher and more like a gentle older sister. Despite that, she is strong-willed enough to fight evil and observant.

She is loved by almost all students, with the males captured by her adult and mature charm. More or less is in romantic or platonic love with Tachibana Ichirou depending on route, and has a lewd teasing nature also towards Futaba Lily Ramses. She is some of the few people that without harsh words can make Lily correct her own mistakes.

Yuuko viewed the former Witch of the Ocean almost as a mother.

Appearance
She has black/blue hair and green eyes.

History
Background
Morino Yuuko 6
A teacher at Higashisaka Kitano Academy Tachibana Ichirou character's homeroom teacher. Winner of the 58th and 59th Miss Higashisaka Kitano Academy Contest. The winner of the 32nd Tohsaka Kitano Academy "My Wife" Award chosen by the faculty and staff.

In fact, she is a renowned witch known as the "Witch of the Ocean". She was taught by the grandmother of Tachibana Ichirou, the previous "Witch of the Ocean". Yuuko, and her sister lost their guardians quickly and were taken both in by the Witch of the Ocean, but her sister's body was weak, and she died shortly afterward. Regardless, Yuuko viewed the Witch of the ocean as her own family.

Yuuko later saved Kaya Blanche from Eisen Faust but was too late to rescue Kaya's mother, Yuuko later trained Kaya, which quit her training to join the magical association that hunted dark wizards like Eisen Faust. When her former master's life came to its end, Yuuko promised to act as a guardian of Ichirou and protect him from overzealous witches and evil sorceress which would use his powers.

Yuuko later is asked by Futaba Lily Ramses to be her mentor as a witch, but Yuuko has not yet agreed to take another student.

Visual Novels
Morino Yuuko 3
The matter of teaching Lily is pushed further back, as Lily by mistake cursed Ichirou, which now transformed into a demonic tentacle monster. To keep the monster part of Ichirou under control, she becomes one of his wives and shares her magic with him which allows him to change back into human form, but the transformation continues, as light signs of horns and symbols begin to spawn on his body. Together, they fought the evil sorcerer Eisen Faust, and stopped the revival of Sorcerer Faust in Tachibana Ichirou's body.

Kaya is taken, and Ichirou tries to rescue her and defeat Faust together with Futaba Lily Ramses and Morino Yuuko. Depending on route, some details change, which lead either to Ichirou using her grandmothers power using the charm she had left him or uses the transformation he obtained as a vessel for Faust. Regardless Eisen Faust is defeated, and Futaba Lily Ramses, Morino Yuuko or Kaya Blanche become his consensual wives/consensual slaves, in a happy ending.

Both LILITH-IZM 04 Tanned Skin and LILITH-IZM 06 Digital anime with Lily & Lilia: Another Story add additional scenes, making the Lily route the most canon.

Timeline TABA
Joins Lily to another universe hunting. They hunted down Guignol Faust which came from their own world and attacked many people in Tokyo Kingdom. With the help of Fuuma Kotaro they disarmed the witch and returned with her and the Brain Flayer that moved them there to their own world.

It is unknown if a version of her also existed in the TABA timeline natively.

Timeline RPGX
Morino Yuuko RPGX
Has been mentioned as a teacher of Futaba Lily Ramses, within the RPGX Taimanin universe.

Just like, in the main canon, a teacher at Higashisaka Kitano Academy. It is mentioned that she worked at Gokou Academy but had moved to Kitano for the protection of Tachibana Ichiro. The same events, from the normal timeline line, occur. However, as Tachibana Ichiro is transformed by the mysterious vendor, Yuuko decides to move back to Gokou, with Ichirou and Futaba Lily Ramses being protected as students. As Lily, learned in Yomihara that the ancient curse could only be canceled by the one who created it, Yuuko sent out a mercenary to find the vendor in the demon world.

The mercenary, a former Hell Knight named Coolidge was captured on her quest, and a group of Onmyoji, including Lily, Yuuko, Kurahashi Hokuto and Danyang Hua are sent out to rescue her. The group is separated when they reach the mansion in which Coolidge was last seen. Lily fights against the one responsible Lady of the Ruins a servant of Sorcerer Faust. Ichiro reveals himself and saves Lily from the Lady, canceling the dust shield the lady was using, and a large water spell of Yuuko killed the demon witch.

After, the group returned with Coolidge, Ichiro and the unconscious Lily, to Gokou Academy, Yuuko apologizes to Kibino Miki the headmaster, for not noticing Ichiro following the group with invisibility magic. As Miki and other Onmyoji were more convinced of Ichiro being potentially dangerous. The death of Ichirou could be avoided and Yuuko, decides once again that he will not fall into the hands of Faust or turn evil, in the name of her old master the original Witch of the Ocean.

Additional Material
Adaption of good ending route, with Futaba Lily Ramses and Ichirou.
